summary: AI Engineer with years building production LLM systems at JudgeService, a customer-insight platform for UK car dealerships. Shipped two AI products now live across major dealer groups: a review-reply service handling over 100k reviews a month with roughly 93% of drafts published unedited, and a multi-agent sentiment pipeline (0.98 F1) that powers client dashboards, feeds the company's complaint-handling platform and contributed to a 20% lift in client retention. Hands-on across RAG, vector databases, Python, Fine-Tuning, evaluation design, FastAPI services, Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and GPU serving on AWS and on-prem.
